expectation: Nuclear stain in a minority of cells (Tregs, CD3+CD4+): small, discrete, nucleus-sized spots scattered as single cells, sometimes clustered in lymphoid or T-cell-rich areas, mostly on CD4+ cells. Rare and sometimes dim in tumours.
observed: A: most tissue fragments carry sparse, discrete, uniformly sized yellow spots, denser in T-rich fragments; a few have diffuse haze. B/C: nearly empty, only a few tight spots. D: a compact nuclear-sized bright cell. E: bright FOXP3 spots, nuclear-sized, sit inside CD4-high areas (green on magenta).
why: Discrete nuclear-sized FOXP3 spots form a sparse, cell-specific population concentrated in CD4-rich tissue, as expected for Tregs, not haze or debris.
notes: FOXP3 shows a sparse population of discrete, nucleus-sized positive cells across the tissue fragments and concentrated in CD4-rich fields (E3). B and C are mostly empty, as expected for a rare marker. Some fragments have mild background haze.
